finding.summary: A held manual 200 can commit after sign-out or replace a more recent successful sign-in.
finding.expected: Keep sign-out or the replacement admission and discard the held success.
finding.reachability: Reproduced for overlapping public service calls. The normal SwiftUI form disables manual submit while busy. SwiftUI was inspected from source.

cancellation: Cancellation before sign-out or after re-admission preserved the replacement for manual and restore with held 200, 401 and 404. Restore returned CancellationError and manual sign-in returned URLError.cancelled.

from hashlib import sha256
from importlib.util import module_from_spec, spec_from_file_location
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys


def replace_once(source, old, new):
    if source.count(old) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected probe source around {old!r}")
    return source.replace(old, new)


delivery = Path(sys.argv.pop(1))
review = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
patch = delivery / "fieldlog-cold-restore-p2.patch"
if sha256(patch.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != "37d25a74eaca0b1fc4e65162cc5c2ff60fbec3feaf9a7be8170a3c82a7eaeb61":
    raise RuntimeError("P2 overlay checksum mismatch")

probe = (delivery / "ColdRestoreProbe.swift").read_text()
probe = replace_once(probe, 'case "cycle", "admit", "rotate":', '''
    case "cycle", "admit", "rotate", "cancel-before-cycle", "cancel-after-cycle":
      if fixture.action == "cancel-before-cycle" { pending.cancel() }'''.strip())
probe = replace_once(probe, 'if fixture.action == "cycle" {', '''
      if ["cycle", "cancel-before-cycle", "cancel-after-cycle"].contains(fixture.action) {'''.strip())
probe = replace_once(probe, '    case "signout":', '''
      if fixture.action == "cancel-after-cycle" { pending.cancel() }
    case "signout":'''.rstrip())
probe = replace_once(probe, '    case .failure(is CancellationError):\n      result = "cancelled"', '''
    case .failure(is CancellationError):
      result = "cancelled"
    case .failure(let error as URLError) where error.code == .cancelled:
      result = "url-cancelled"
'''.rstrip())
probe = replace_once(probe, '      try require(store.bytes == replacementBytes, "replacement bytes preserved")', '''
      if store.bytes != replacementBytes, fixture.operation == "manual", result == "admitted-online" {
        struct Identity: Decodable { let admissionID: UUID? }
        let replacementID = try JSONDecoder().decode(Identity.self, from: replacementBytes).admissionID
        let committedID = try store.identity()
        try require(committedID != nil && committedID != replacementID && committedID != initialIdentity,
          "stale manual response committed a third identity")
        try require(saved.accountID == fixture.account && saved.scope == fixture.scope
          && saved.token == fixture.token, "original manual submission was persisted")
        return result + ":overwrote-replacement"
      }
      try require(store.bytes == replacementBytes, "replacement bytes preserved")
'''.rstrip())
(review / "ColdRestoreProbe.swift").write_text(probe)

runner = (delivery / "verify-admission-instance.py").read_text()
runner = replace_once(runner, '{"cycle", "admit", "rotate"}',
                      '{"cycle", "admit", "rotate", "cancel-before-cycle", "cancel-after-cycle"}')
(review / "verify-admission-instance.py").write_text(runner)
shutil.copyfile(patch, review / patch.name)
spec = spec_from_file_location("p2_review", review / "verify-admission-instance.py")
verifier = module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(verifier)

verifier.RACES = []
verifier.CONTROLS = [
    ("manual-old-200-after-sign-out", "manual", "signout", "all", False, 200, "admitted-online:saved"),
    ("manual-old-200-after-same-readmission", "manual", "cycle", "all", False, 200,
     "admitted-online:overwrote-replacement"),
    ("manual-old-200-after-bearer-rotation", "manual", "rotate", "all", False, 200,
     "admitted-online:overwrote-replacement"),
    ("manual-old-404-after-same-readmission", "manual", "cycle", "all", False, 404,
     "rejected:replacement"),
    ("manual-old-401-after-bearer-rotation", "manual", "rotate", "all", False, 401,
     "rejected:replacement"),
    ("restore-legacy-offline", "restore", "none", "all", True, 590, "admitted-offline:original"),
] + [
    (f"{operation}-{action}-{status}", operation, action, "all", False, status,
     "cancelled:replacement" if operation == "restore" else "url-cancelled:replacement")
    for operation in ("restore", "manual")
    for action in ("cancel-before-cycle", "cancel-after-cycle")
    for status in (200, 401, 404)
]
raise SystemExit(verifier.main())
